top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Rebound as Chip Rout Loses Steam: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Buyers are driving a rebound in US stocks after last week’s rout in chipmakers, marking an upbeat start to a week in which earnings will put the artificial-intelligence trade to the test once again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay
top_signals.summary: Finance officials are reportedly set to meet major crypto exchanges on Tuesday, days after a lawmaker introduced legislation that could push the tax’s start date back two years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
